note: Anthropic's own claimed refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, posted hours after OpenAI's: a paper credited to Claude giving a 2^o(n)-time algorithm for 3-SAT, found by an internal research model, with a Lean formalisation checked against separately stated theorems. The repository notes that no machine checks that the Lean statements say what the paper says.
title: A 2^o(n) Time Algorithm for 3-SAT (paper and Lean formalisation)
